text: {"lessons":["Recent price moves have not reliably signaled what comes next, so I should not trade on the assumption that a trend will continue or reverse.","Selling Stock A above my average cost did not prevent my account value from later falling; I should base decisions on forward-looking risk and portfolio fit, not gains or losses versus cost alone.","My account has fluctuated even when I made no trades, so I should manage risk with a deliberate plan and avoid letting loss aversion or frequent monitoring trigger impulsive changes."]}
